Card Q&A.q: Can I choose cards so that the combined play cost is lower than the play cost of 1 of my Digimon with [Greymon] in their name on purpose with this card's effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This card's effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that can't attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I attack with one of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name that is suspended or was played this turn with this card's effect?
Does the [When Attacking] effect of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name activates when it attacks with this card's effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This card's effect only allows you to attack a player.
Card Q&A.q: Can I attack one of my opponent's Digimon instead of a player with one of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name that has the effect "This Digimon can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon" with this card's effect?

Effect: When you would use this card, if you have a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards in play, reduce the cost by 2.

[Main] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon and/or Tamers whose combined play costs are less than or equal to the play cost of 1 of your Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, and delete all of the chosen cards. Then, 1 of your Digimon with [Greymon] in its name may attack a player.
Security Effect: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the highest play cost.
